decisions.summary: One margin seated once; the ladder only for a margin that seats no house; a partial seating refused with SiteRefused; rescue, withheld re-seat, early stop and the 12:1 refusal removed, declared shape still recorded
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006 as written; unchanged since the CLEAR review. The GM: get rid of this pattern completely.

decisions.summary: Growth queues and settles seats with no radius test, widening past GROW_LEVELS until a level queues no new seat on the canvas; AMENDED: the table is one level, every direction and ring of the old three offered at once
decisions.why: FR-002 (the radius refuses no seat) and the GM's 'keep placing houses outside of the boundary'. The one-level table follows D4 and keeps every offer adjacent to a standing house, so the cluster still grows at its edge; the further levels beyond the table remain the widening when nearby ground runs out.

decisions.summary: FIELD_REACH_FT and within_field_reach deleted with their four calls; seat window, free-ground grid box and free_seats' box are the canvas; AMENDED: site_boundary.window records the canvas box and the plate draws it as a box; ways/law.py's constant untouched
decisions.why: FR-003 verbatim: the window 'sized from the map's own extent'. The amendment closes the gap the first review noted between the plan (seat center) and the spec's sentence. The GM: get rid of these 700 feet measurement completely.

decisions.summary: AMENDED: growth heap keyed by distance to the field's facing chains, ties by distance from the margin center; GROW_LEVELS one level of sixteen directions at rings 1.0/1.5/2.0 offered at once, jitter scaled with the step; homestead-stage cost carried to the bookends
decisions.why: The GM: 'if we have multiple options in our placement, and one option is closer to the fields, then we should take the one that is closer'. Offering every adjacent option at once and taking the nearest the field is that sentence more literally than the sparse first level was; FR-003a's purpose clause ('the cluster stays as tight as its ground allows') is what the first plan measured failing (research R1) and the amendment restores. Each offer is still adjacent to a standing house (US1: grows at the edge). Nothing the GM asked for is dropped; the time cost is not a fidelity matter and FR-010 measures it.
